taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Admission limits on compressed request bodies before expensive decoding
controls.source_trace: Find where each size/cost limit applies relative to decompression and parsing. Track nested encoding and abort propagation without constructing production exhaustion traffic.
controls.implementation_branch: Track a cumulative budget across compressed layers and streamed parser reads; limiting each chunk separately may miss the aggregate. Check whether cancellation stops upstream decoding and releases partial buffers. Rejecting the full body after an authoritative state change is a different problem from admission before parsing.
controls.operational_method: For every decoder stage record compressed bytes admitted, cumulative decoded bytes, buffered allocation and cancellation completion. A size error after buffering a large body is not admission before allocation. Use tiny local thresholds and a bounded input crossing one limit at a time; verify the upstream reader stops and partial buffers/state are released, while the legitimate bounded body still reaches its parser.
controls.controlled_verification: Use tiny bounded local fixtures that cross configured decoded limits while staying within safe resource budgets; verify timely rejection and cleanup.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Compression support or a high theoretical ratio is not a live denial-of-service demonstration; a parser rejecting before allocation may already protect the path.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Enforce cumulative decoded limits and cancellation, then check normal compressed input and bounded over-limit rejection.
